---
title: "Quizkit demo"
---

A demo of quizkit.

::: {.quiz lockout="5"}

::: {.question}
What is 2 + 2?

- [ ] 3

    Close — that's 2 + 1. Add *one* more.
- [x] 4

    Right: **2 + 2 = 4**.
- [ ] 5

::: {.feedback .correct}
Nice — this addition is the foundation for everything that follows.
:::

::: {.feedback .wrong}
Count up from 2 by two more: 3, then **4**.
:::
:::

::: {.question}
Which are prime? (select all)

- [x] 2
- [x] 3
- [ ] 4
- [x] 5

::: {.feedback}
A prime has exactly two divisors: 1 and itself.
:::
:::

::: {.question answer="7" tolerance="0" submit="Confirm answer"}
How many integers x satisfy |x - 10| ≤ 3? Type the number.
:::

::: {.question .kprim}
Rate each statement.

- [x] Every integer is a rational number.

    Because ℤ ⊂ ℚ — every integer *n* equals *n*/1.
- [ ] Pi is a rational number.

    Pi is irrational (proved by Lambert, 1761).
:::

::: {.reveal}
Nicely done — you finished the demo quiz.
:::

:::

## Opt-out example (no progress bar, no persistence)

::: {.quiz progress="false" persist="false"}

::: {.question submit="Lock it in"}
Which of these is a prime number?

- [ ] 9
- [x] 11
- [ ] 15
:::

:::

## Shuffle example (randomised option and question order)

::: {.quiz shuffle="true" shuffle-questions="true"}

::: {.question}
Pick the even number.

- [ ] 3
- [x] 4
- [ ] 7
:::

::: {.question}
Pick the vowel.

- [x] a
- [ ] b
- [ ] c
:::

::: {.question}
Pick the largest.

- [ ] 1
- [ ] 2
- [x] 3
:::

:::
